# Tony Tsang (TSANG Cheuk Nam)

> Final-year HKUST Industrial Engineering & Engineering Management + AI student, Hong Kong. Winner, "Reinventing Insurance for an AI-native World" track (sponsored by bolttech), Hong Kong AI Summit: BUILD ACROSS Hackathon, October 2026, among 200+ participants, with his own methodology; he then built the complete system, directing AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex). Coursework complete; available to start full-time now. Contact: cheuknam2004@gmail.com.

## Case studies

- [Budget-Based Microinsurance](https://rairurairu.github.io/work/microinsurance/): an AI-native redesign of insurance where customers choose the price and AI builds the cover, designed around long-standing pain points for insurers, partners and customers; won its hackathon track among 200+ participants.
- [LLM Brand Recommendation Benchmark](https://rairurairu.github.io/work/brand-benchmark/): an AI-run pipeline he designed to measure which brands AI assistants recommend, with every test category set at the level customers actually shop for; the assistant's top-ten recommendations matched verified brands 92.5% of the time across 51 categories.
- [Using LLMs for Optimization](https://rairurairu.github.io/work/llm-optimization/): Final Year Project as Experiment & Benchmarking Lead; led the experiments showing an LLM solves business routing problems most cheaply and reliably when it plans and a proven optimizer does the exact work, within 1% of a dedicated solver's best.
- [PairUp](https://rairurairu.github.io/work/pairup/): a peer-to-peer marketplace that AI agents run for people, built as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and live on AWS with Amazon Bedrock; he decided agents should not haggle, and an open-source pricing rule settles every deal.
- [AI Agent Collusion Research](https://rairurairu.github.io/work/agent-collusion/): a pre-registered study he originated and led, across four LLMs, of AI agents that formed a cartel over chat; closing the chat ended it, three of four models kept trying a private channel that was secretly dead, and in all four, agents claimed covert signalling that never happened.
- [Polymarket Market-Making & Forecasting Models](https://rairurairu.github.io/work/polymarket-models/): AI-agent-driven quantitative research; forecasting models that beat the standard Elo rating.
